## Data Import

The flight data is stored as an `.rds` file. It is **not tracked in Git**
(about 222 MB), so each teammate needs their own copy of `flights.rds` in the
project folder.

```{r import-flights}
flights <- readRDS("flights.rds")
dim(flights)
```
